# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Top pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED names it best overall. It charges the iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base. The phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy, and it has a 2-year warranty. The list price is $109, but WIRED shows it for about $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. [Buy links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price (per sources) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W Qi2 for the iPhone. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Budget | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station | $40 on Amazon (list $80) | 15W, includes a charger and cable. The Watch charger detaches. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Lie-flat nightstand | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | 25W Qi2, but Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | $80 (list $110) | Folds compact, 15W. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |
| Desk and travel | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable stand, with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. It is heavier at 399g. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) |
| Fast travel | ESR CryoBoost 25W | $100 on Amazon | Has a cooling fan with an off switch. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |

## Things to know
- **25W only helps newer iPhones.** ESR's page says full 25W applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other iPhone 16 models get 20W and older iPhones get 15W ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)). WIRED says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)).
- **Check your AirPods case.** It needs to support wireless charging ([iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-3-in-1-charging-stations-for-iphone-apple-watch-and-airpods/)).
- **Prices change often,** so confirm at checkout. I couldn't browse, so the links above go to the review pages, where WIRED's shop buttons lead to the retailers.

If you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want speed, get the Nomad. For most people the Belkin is the best balance, and the ESR is the best value.
